name: Joram
summary: A son of Ahab who ruled Israel from Samaria for twelve years. He did evil, though not like his parents, and was shot by Jehu in the field of Naboth.

key_moments.title: Puts Away Baal's Image
key_moments.description: Joram became king of Israel, ruling from Samaria. He did evil, though less than his father and mother, for he removed the Baal image his father made.

key_moments.title: Given Water and Victory over Moab
key_moments.description: When Moab rebelled, Joram marched with the kings of Judah and Edom, and their army ran out of water. Elisha said the LORD would fill the valley with water, and in the morning it came and Moab was beaten.

key_moments.title: Wounded in Battle
key_moments.description: Joram went to battle against Hazael, Syria's king, at Ramoth-gilead and was wounded. He went back to Jezreel to heal.

key_moments.title: Shot by Jehu
key_moments.description: Joram rode out to meet Jehu and asked if he came in peace. Jehu said there could be no peace while Jezebel's sins and witchcraft were so many, and he shot Joram through the heart.
